decisions.reason: This core track spotlight line sits close to the established offer and has been shown on its own page for two years, so keeping it is cheap and its value is still unfolding.
The ceiling luminaire line has stayed prominently presented since 2023 and fits the firm's core range, so the low carrying cost justifies holding the option.
The flexible spotlight line launched only in 2024, so its uncertainty has not yet resolved, and it adds little cost to the established system portfolio.
The multi-outlet canopy is a low-cost system accessory that extends the modular offer and is too new to judge, so the option is worth more than its upkeep.
The low-voltage canopy is a recent complementary accessory with uncertain but plausible value and minimal carrying cost, so dropping it would be premature.
The glass track luminaires are only mentioned rather than featured, which suggests weaker commitment, but they are new and cheap to keep while their results resolve.
